items.title: Pay 'processing fee' to release claimed refund
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for this payment: 'bis zum 27.11.2026'. No period calculation is needed; this is the date as printed. However, this appears to be an advance-fee scam demanding payment before any refund is released — see warnings. The recommendation is NOT to pay this, regardless of the date.

warnings: This letter shows strong hallmarks of an advance-fee ('Vorkasse') scam: an unsolicited, unusually large refund (612,00 €) is offered for ordinary energy bills, but release is conditioned on first paying a smaller 'processing fee' (49,90 €) — a classic fraud pattern.

The sender's address and the payment IBAN (CY17..., checksum-valid but a Cypriot account) are both in Cyprus, which is implausible for a German consumer energy-refund office; genuine German energy refunds are issued by your actual supplier or via Bundesnetzagentur/consumer-protection channels, never via a foreign shell address.
The letter uses time pressure and an irreversible-loss threat ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig') to rush payment — a common manipulation tactic in scam letters.

There is no verifiable link to any real energy contract, supplier, or billing period; no Vertragsnummer or Kundennummer of an actual electricity/gas provider is given, only an invented 'Erstattungsnummer'.

Do not transfer the 49,90 € fee or any other sum to the given IBAN; genuine refunds are never conditioned on an upfront fee. Consider reporting this letter to the Verbraucherzentrale NRW and/or the police (Internetbeschwerdestelle) instead of paying.

Compare it with earlier letters or the sender's official website; if a letter or email says the account has changed, confirm that through contact details you already know before paying. For a euro transfer to this account the bank also checks the payee's name against the account before it is sent (Empfängerüberprüfung, required in the euro area since 9 October 2025): if it reports no match or only a close one, or says the check was not possible, do not pay until you have confirmed the account.","disclaimer":"Information, not legal or financial advice: what the IBAN's own characters show, checked by Ordnung's code. It cannot tell whether the account exists or who holds it."}
